question: Why does a Comet virtual CD bugcheck 0x69 before the boot-device poll runs?
allowedInputs: output/hardware-toolkit/serial-20261114T050244Z.log reports ARC path cdrom(111), IopCreateArcNames failed: c0000034, then Fatal System Error 0x00000069. usbstor and cdrom loaded and no storage device was created before that failure.

ntoskrnl/io/iomgr/iomgr.c IopMarkBootPartition retries IopCreateArcNames while PollBootPartitionTimeout is counting. IoInitSystem returns before that function when the first IopCreateArcNames call fails.
ntoskrnl/ex/init.c calls KeBugCheck(IO1_INITIALIZATION_FAILED) when IoInitSystem returns FALSE.
Reported: Ryan Wilson said the GL.iNet Comet mounts the ISO and the Shuttle has to boot from that virtual media.
